text:
ashley: FYI — ACME staging started seeing 401s immediately after we ran the Vault rewrap for their API key at 08:12 UTC. Only staging (behind auth-proxy + CDN) affected, prod is fine.

ben: Any sample request/response we can use to repro?

ashley: Repro curl I used: 
```
curl -i -H 'Authorization: Bearer sk_live_OLD' -b 'session=eyJ...' https://staging-api.redwood.example.com/v1/generate
```
Response: 401 Unauthorized from auth-proxy, upstream returns 200 if I remove cookie.

infra-bot: rotation: vault/tenant/acme-staging rewrap completed at 5155551200 (job#4221)

samir: I can repro locally. If both session cookie and Authorization header present, auth-proxy validates the cookie first and rejects because session store still bound to the old key. Removing cookie -> auth header works.

jordan: That implies sessions weren't invalidated on key rotate. Could be CDN/proxy caching Set-Cookie or the session store (redis) still has old token binding. Have we flushed session cache?

ashley: I flushed the staging Redis and invalidated the CDN edge for acme-staging, customer still hit 401 for a bit until clients restarted. Workaround we gave: ask testers to remove the cookie or send header X-Redwood-Token with the new key to bypass cookie binding.

ben: What's the long-term fix?

samir: Short plan: (1) patch auth-proxy so Authorization header is authoritative when present, even if a cookie exists; (2) on vault rewrap, enqueue session invalidation for tenants that had key scope changes; (3) add a small grace window where proxy accepts both old+new key for 60s to avoid client churn.

jordan: + add a post-rotate hook to call our session invalidation endpoint and CDN invalidation automatically.

ashley: I've opened infra ticket INF-7643 with rollback + patch PR link: https://git.internal/redwood/auth-proxy/pulls/89. Communicated workaround to ACME rep (DM).

ben: Cool. Can we capture repro steps in the support ticket? Putting them there now.

ashley: Putting logs in the ticket: 
```
[auth-proxy] 2026-03-15T08:12:34Z tenant=acme-staging result=401 reason=session-key-mismatch cookie=session=eyJ...
[upstream] 2026-03-15T08:12:34Z request-id=abc123 status=200
```

samir: I'll start the PR review and include the acceptance test that reproduces cookie+auth header case.

jordan: Thanks — mark as high-priority until INF-7643 is merged and deploys to staging. :white_check_mark:
